abstract: The immunoglobulin heavy chain constant (IGHC) locus houses genetic determinates of antibody function and specificity. In this issue of Cell Genomics, Jana et al. use long-read sequencing to characterize extensive inter-individual diversity in the IGHC region across ancestrally diverse populations, highlighting potential functional consequences.
